purpose: Discover a first real supported application surface for a future bounded visual-fallback contract. Use real Safari with local test-owned canvas content to prove a semantic NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET gap, exact local Vision resolution, real Computer Control delivery, and independent visual postcondition without shipping any Safari contract yet.
requiredClaims: If Safari is already running, session execution is blocked before immutable evidence is created so user browser state is protected.
The discovery uses the existing product Safari application Provider and real Safari process/bundle identity.
The tested page is served only from loopback and requires no external network service.
The test-owned target is rendered only into an HTML canvas and is not supplied as accessible fallback text.
After the canvas target is visibly resolved, a fresh Safari Computer Control snapshot does not resolve the target semantically and produces structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
The real product macOS Vision text-region perception provider is selected locally through P5D.
The initial visual observation resolves exactly one target and does not already contain the deterministic postcondition.
The visual action is authorized only through the existing explicit primary-display left-click policy.
Real Computer Control delivery returns canonical CLICK_POSTED with semanticConsequenceVerified=false.
A fresh independent post-action visual observation sees exactly the deterministic postcondition and no longer sees the original target before VERIFIED_SUCCESS is accepted.
No built-in Safari visual fallback contract exists during this discovery and none is created by the session.
Screenshot bytes, OCR payloads and coordinates are not persisted or printed to evidence.
Pointer, Safari process, loopback server, perception cache/runtime and temporary resources are cleaned up; Computer Use and Computer Control trees remain clean.
nonClaims: P6B does not validate a generic Safari visual fallback policy.
P6B does not ship or enable a built-in Safari registry contract.
P6B does not claim that arbitrary web canvas content is safe to click.
P6B does not broaden exact-text matching, action types, display topology or provider capabilities.
P6B does not rerun historical P1-P4 physical sessions or rewrite P5/P6A evidence.
P6B does not claim external-network browser automation or general browser competence.

evidencePolicy.safariUserState: Preflight blocks before session creation when Safari is already running. The physical test repeats the guard for races.
evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s01 unchanged, diagnose the exact Safari/semantic/perception/delivery boundary, fix forward only and create s02 only when necessary.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned page content is used. Screenshot bytes, OCR observation payloads and coordinates remain ephemeral and are not logged.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P6C bounded registry integration/promotion only from evidence-backed caller knowledge
